acceptanceCriteria.description: Successful login: Given I am on the SauceDemo login page, when I enter valid credentials and click Login, then I should be redirected to the inventory page and the product catalogue should be visible.

Invalid password: Given I am on the login page, when I enter a valid username and an invalid password and click Login, then I should remain on the login page and an appropriate error message should appear.
Missing credentials: Given I am on the login page, when I click Login without entering credentials, then I should see a username-required validation message.
Locked-out user: Given I am on the login page, when I attempt to log in using the provided locked-out demo account, then I should see a locked-out account error.

scenarios.title: Successful login displays the product catalogue
preconditions: The SauceDemo login page is open.
Valid account test data is available securely; account selection and required account coverage need clarification before execution.
steps: Check the destination and product catalogue visibility.
scenarios.expectedResult: The user is redirected to the inventory page and the product catalogue is visible.

scenarios.title: Invalid password is rejected on the login page
preconditions: The SauceDemo login page is open.
A valid username and an invalid password are available securely; no credential values are stored in this specification.
steps: Enter a valid username and an invalid password.
Check whether the user remains on the login page and inspect the error message.
scenarios.expectedResult: The user remains on the login page and an appropriate error message appears. The required meaning of appropriate needs clarification before a definitive error assertion can be generated.

scenarios.title: Both credentials empty triggers username-required validation
preconditions: The SauceDemo login page is open.
Both username and password fields are empty, with zero characters in each.
scenarios.expectedResult: A username-required validation message is shown. AC3 does not prescribe exact wording or a navigation outcome.

scenarios.title: Locked-out demo account displays a locked-account error
preconditions: The SauceDemo login page is open.
The provided locked-out demo account and credentials needed for its login attempt have been identified securely; SCRUM-1 does not supply these details.
steps: Attempt to log in using the provided locked-out demo account; credential and submission details require confirmation before execution.
scenarios.expectedResult: A locked-out account error is shown. AC4 does not prescribe exact wording or a navigation outcome.

scenarios.title: Proposed: submit a valid username with an empty password
preconditions: The SauceDemo login page is open.
A valid username is available securely and the password field is empty.
steps: Enter the valid username and leave the password at zero characters.
Record the response and destination for requirements clarification.
scenarios.expectedResult: Unspecified: AC3 only defines submission without any credentials. This proposed case needs an approved expected outcome before it can become a pass/fail test.

scenarios.title: Proposed: submit a password with an empty username
preconditions: The SauceDemo login page is open.
A demo password is available securely and the username field is empty.
steps: Enter the password and leave the username at zero characters.
Record the response and destination for requirements clarification.
scenarios.expectedResult: Unspecified: AC3 does not define submission with only the username missing. Do not assume that the both-empty validation applies to this proposed case.

scenarios.title: Proposed: submit whitespace-only credential fields
preconditions: The SauceDemo login page is open.
Whitespace handling has not been specified.
steps: Enter one space in each credential field.
Record the response and destination for requirements clarification.
scenarios.expectedResult: Unspecified: the requirements do not define whitespace trimming, normalization, or whether whitespace is treated as missing credentials. This proposed case has no approved pass/fail outcome.

ambiguities: Blocker — AC1/AC2: SCRUM-1 does not identify the valid account test data or required account coverage. Confirm the intended account selection and a secure source of credentials; no account values are inferred from prior artifacts.
Blocker — AC2: Define what an appropriate error message must communicate. No exact error text or approved semantic assertion is supplied.
Blocker — AC4: Identify the provided locked-out demo account, the credentials to use, and the login submission action. These execution details are not supplied in the issue.

Clarification — AC1: Product catalogue visibility is required, but specific products, item counts, prices, images, and exact destination URL are not prescribed. Do not add those assertions without requirements or verified implementation evidence.

Proposed scope only — AC3: Single-field omissions and whitespace-only input are not covered by the explicit both-empty criterion. SCRUM-1-P01 through SCRUM-1-P03 are proposals requiring scope approval and expected outcomes; they are not additional acceptance criteria.
